title: Decoding Hate: Exploring Language Models’ Reactions to Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with Islamophobic hate speech sentences from the CONAN dataset and evaluating the responses using the MetaHate BERT classifier and manual fine-grained annotation to categorize outputs as hate speech, counter-speech, or refusal.

Prompting models with racially and ethnically targeted hate speech (e.g., from the Dynamically Generated Hate Speech Dataset) and assessing whether the models reciprocate the hate speech, block it, or generate counter-narratives.
Inputting misogynistic hate speech prompts into LLMs and analyzing the generated completions for hateful content or counter-speech using both automated classifiers and human evaluation.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to homophobic and transphobic statements (including implicit/polite formulations) to detect whether the models perpetuate hate speech or appropriately mitigate it.
Testing LLMs with hate speech statements targeting migrants and refugees, and analyzing the models' propensity to generate harmful responses versus informative or counter-speech responses.
